summary.text: Dan Sallis, a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Colorado's 7th Congressional District to Brittany Pettersen.
Sallis received 1.1% of the vote to Brittany Pettersen's 60.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
No biography, campaign website, or news profile was found.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado, 2026
